entry.title: EU Space Act: EP committee vote is late against the forecast
entry.summary: The forecast expects it around 12 Apr 2027. It keeps its median of publication only if the step comes by 10 Aug 2026; it has not come since 11 Aug 2026. On 8 Sep 2025, when the procedure reached its current step, the median of publication in the Official Journal was 13 Aug 2027; it held within 14 days only if the step came by 10 Aug 2026. The step is overdue: the median now stands at 7 Jun 2028. If the step came on 22 Oct 2026, the median would be 8 Nov 2027.

entry.title: Forecast method changed: 2 medians moved by two months or more
entry.summary: After the change of 14 Oct 2026, up to 2 months; the earlier forecasts are kept in the archive. The procedures did not move: the method of the forecast changed, and with it the median of publication of each act listed.
